title: God specializes in redemption. 🔥
paragraphs:
The people God used most…
were often the people who fell the hardest.

• Moses — a murderer who fled into the wilderness.
• David — a king who committed adultery and tried to hide it.
• Peter — a disciple who denied Jesus three times.
By human standards, their stories should have ended in failure.

“I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten…”
— Joel 2:25

God doesn’t just forgive.
He restores.

He restores purpose.
He restores calling.
He restores the years sin tried to destroy.
Your worst chapter does not cancel God’s plan for your life.
If you feel disqualified because of your past, remember:

God is not looking for perfect people.
He is looking for repentant hearts.

The same God who restored Moses, David, and Peter
is still restoring lives today.
If you believe God still restores broken lives today…
